warning_source: IDF Gaza Division Northern Brigade — Maj. Einav Feldman; officer Elad; corroborated by Col. Haim Cohen refusal
recipient: Supt. Nivi Ohana and senior Negev police approval chain; Southern Command HQ in reconsideration chain
warning_summary: Northern Brigade opposed extending the Re'im/Nova mass event into Saturday, describing the expanded event as a materially different and problematic security configuration; later IDF inquiry says Col. Haim Cohen refused because of the event's size/proximity and reduced holiday-weekend troop availability.
evidence_update: Later-released contemporaneous police protocols published by Shomrim (27 Mar 2025) directly record the Oct. 4 warning; Ynet's 3 Apr 2025 reporting of the IDF Nova inquiry independently corroborates Cohen's refusal and Southern Command intervention; official IDF expert review on 10 Nov 2025 accepted the Nova inquiry findings. Published to Notion as WARN-122, High confidence.
gaps: Not an imminent-Hamas-attack warning. Azoulay later said Southern Command CoS Manor Yanai told him the initial refusal was not based on specific unusual intelligence. Exact reason/path for Oct. 5 reversal remains partly unresolved.

warning_source: Col. Haim Cohen — Northern Brigade commander, Gaza Division
recipient: Southern Command commander Yaron Finkelman, according to Cohen's later farewell speech
warning_summary: Cohen later said the Gaza sector was 'boiling' about 1.5 months before Oct. 7 and that he recommended an opening/preemptive strike, which he says was rejected on the assessment that Hamas was deterred and seeking concessions.
evidence_update: Israel Hayom reported Cohen's 10 Apr 2025 farewell speech and simultaneously reported that people around outgoing Southern Command commander Yaron Finkelman denied Cohen's account.
gaps: No contemporaneous warning record, exact warning date, meeting record, recipient acknowledgment or independent event-level corroboration recovered. Post-event 'I warned them' claim therefore remains below acceptance threshold; denial must be preserved.

warning_source: Brig. Gen. Shlomi Binder — commander, Division 91
warning_summary: Binder reportedly warned that the northern defense plan based on a small routine-security force could not withstand a significant surprise attack.
evidence_update: Rechecked recent IDF/Dado Center professional synthesis, which groups Binder with successor Shay Klapper as commanders who warned the army about the surprise-attack defense gap.
gaps: Exact date, exact recipient, contemporaneous warning record and independent event-level corroboration remain missing. No promotion.
